market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely under pressure from Middle East oil shock, rising RBA rate expectations, and property sector stress. Qantas strike and Star Entertainment overhang add idiosyncratic risk. Expect volatility with sector rotation toward energy, gold, and large-cap banks. Sentiment remains cautious.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook stabilises if Middle East de-escalates and RBA holds. Iron ore weakness caps mining upside, but gold/rare earths exploration and AI infrastructure capex provide structural growth. Property sector may stabilise post-credit contraction. Consumer shift to EVs and health products supports selective staples exposure.
